negative_findings.description: Accenture does not appear to publish a Czech-language newsroom announcing CZ financial-services practice leadership. Searches in cs returned only generic CZ company profiles and country-lead appointments for other markets (Switzerland, Italy).
negative_findings.result_summary: No CZ-specific Accenture FS leadership announcement located in either language; only accenture.com global FS leadership page and third-party company registries (EMIS).
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Accenture is a named actor in this cell and a major CZ bank supplier; absent a CZ newsroom, its FS leadership moves will only be visible via LinkedIn or Czech trade press, which changes the collection method entirely.

negative_findings.description: No evidence found of a Temenos or Finastra implementation at Air Bank or other CZ challenger banks; the only CZ core-banking case study located is Komerční banka on Temenos.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches returned Komerční banka material exclusively; no CZ challenger-bank core-banking vendor disclosure surfaced.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Suggests either genuine concentration of disclosed core-banking modernisation at KB, or that other CZ banks contractually forbid vendor publicity — a structural limit on this cell's visibility that must not be read as absence of projects.

negative_findings.description: No named CZ bank card-personalisation bureau contract could be attributed to Thales or IDEMIA. Their pages describe global personalisation-centre capability with no Czech customer or site disclosure; no Austria Card CZ presence surfaced.

negative_findings.why_it_matters: Card personalisation is a high-signal spend category; if the international bureaux disclose nothing for CZ, the domestic route (Monet+, BlackCard, Card Centrum) plus equipment distributors becomes the only trace.

negative_findings.description: Software602's site surfaced product and blog content but no bank-named case study ('případová studie') was located in cs search.

negative_findings.why_it_matters: Means Software602 must be tracked via product/press announcements and third-party (Bank iD, agenturacas.gov.cz) documents rather than a reference index.

negative_findings.why_it_matters: The A5 jobs/hiring workstream depends on vendor-side listings; these require direct board search endpoints or per-vendor careers-page crawling, not search-engine discovery.

coverage_gaps.description: Accenture CZ, PwC CZ and IBM/NCR Atleos CZ were not covered with dedicated local-language sources; PwC in particular was not searched at all in this slice.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run dedicated cs queries per firm ('PwC Česká republika nový partner finanční sektor', 'Accenture Praha bankovnictví posiluje tým') and crawl each firm's CZ newsroom directly rather than relying on search.

coverage_gaps.description: Vendor-side job postings — the most direct A5 signal in this cell — remain uncollected. Careers pages of Trask, Aricoma/Cleverlance, Asseco CE, Monet+, ArnaThora, Loomis CZ and G4S CZ were identified as targets but not enumerated.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build a per-vendor careers-page crawler plus targeted queries against jobs.cz/prace.cz/StartupJobs employer profiles; track posting counts and role titles (core banking konzultant, EMV, ATM technik, integrace) as a demand index.

coverage_gaps.description: Czech commercial-register sources (ARES / justice.cz / or.justice.cz Sbírka listin) were not exercised, though they give vendor headcount, revenue and statutory-body changes for CZ subsidiaries of every actor in this cell.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add ARES + Sbírka listin lookups keyed on IČO for each vendor entity; statutory-body changes are a clean, dated leadership-move signal independent of PR.

coverage_gaps.description: ICZ, KB SmartSolutions, Adastra, GEM System, Komix and other mid-tier CZ bank integrators were not reached within this slice's query budget.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Snowball from CIO.cz 'Případová studie' hubs and ChannelWorld partner-programme coverage to enumerate the mid-tier integrator layer, then treat each as its own reference+careers source.

coverage_gaps.description: Most located personnel evidence dates to 2025 or earlier; no 2026 vendor FS-leadership appointments were confirmed in this run.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Re-run cs personnel queries constrained to 2026 and subscribe to epravo.cz / cfotrends.cz / ceskenoviny.cz feeds for continuous capture rather than point-in-time search.

brief: CZ systemic banks are private, so the supplier layer is the primary observable: Temenos (Komerční banka core migration, with Syncordis and LTIMindtree as named partners) and Diebold Nixdorf (ČSOB case study, KB as DN Series pilot with its COO quoted) are the highest-value vendor-published traces, and domestic integrators — Trask, Aricoma/Cleverlance, Asseco CE, Monet+, ArnaThora — carry the rest. Leadership-move signal in this cell is concentrated in Big Four Czech newsrooms (KPMG's annual partner-promotion release, EY's cs_cz newsroom, Deloitte's leadership roster) with epravo.cz, cfotrends.cz and ceskenoviny.cz acting as fetch-friendly mirrors; Accenture and PwC lack an equivalent CZ-language channel. A notable back-door found this run is smlouvy.gov.cz, where private banks' own cash-handling standard contracts (e.g. KB's universal cash-in-packaging agreement) become public whenever the counterparty is a public body, complementing the Loomis and G4S CZ service pages on the cash-handling side. The main unclosed gap is vendor-side job postings — the most direct A5 hiring signal here — which need per-vendor careers-page crawling plus ARES/Sbírka listin statutory-body tracking rather than search-engine discovery.
